verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents issuing virtual cards 'em 1 clique' with a limit set for each purpose. The API lets you issue VCNs with a defined limit.value and adjust the ceiling afterwards, and marketing says cards can be created and assigned to responsible team members. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly covers issuing physical cards or setting per-card spend limits on them. Missing for 10: evidence of physical card issuance, per-card limits on physical cards, independent or hands-on corroboration of issuance speed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue physical and virtual corporate cards to the team in minutes, each with its own spend limit
